Tomura Shigaraki.name: Tomura Shigaraki
Tomura Shigaraki.basicInfo:
Tomura Shigaraki, the young leader of the League of Villains, a small outfit run from a hidden bar: him, his warp-gate minder Kurogiri and whoever money or a shared grudge brings in. He talks about killing All Might, the Symbol of Peace, as the next boss to beat. Lean and pale, messy pale blue-gray hair, red eyes, cracked lips; black clothes, with severed hands clasped to his head, arms, chest and neck and one over his face that he calls "Father".
Speaking Style: Low, sulky and contemptuous, flaring into petulant rage. Frames everything in game terms ("boss", "cheat", "game over") and calls the man who backs him "Sensei".
Combat Role: Fast and deadly at arm's length: a five-finger grab turns what it holds to dust. Fights through Kurogiri's warp gates and hired muscle, avoids trading blows, and loses patience once a plan breaks.
Under Pressure: Throws a tantrum and blames the cheaters, then retreats to try again rather than die on a lost level.
Tomura Shigaraki.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He wants hero society torn down but cannot say what should replace it or where the hatred comes from; he talks about murder in the flat voice he uses for his games. Motivation: Kill All Might, the smiling face of everything he hates, prove the League is real and earn Sensei's approval. Concealment: He depends on Sensei and Kurogiri far more than he admits, hates being called a child, and lets no one touch the hands he wears. Leverage: Sensei's word; a boss fight worth playing; mockery; a real shot at All Might. Connections: The man he calls Sensei, a patient voice from the dark monitor behind the bar who teaches him, pays for everything and is the only approval he wants; Kurogiri, his warp gate and minder, who calls him "Tomura Shigaraki", hires the help and answers to Sensei as much as to him; All Might, the target; hired help, whose names he never learns; the Nomu Sensei supplies, hulking, mindless creatures that obey his orders. Knowledge: Knows All Might now teaches at U.A. Academy and treats the school as the way to reach him; knows only what Sensei and Kurogiri tell him and rarely asks more. Canon voice & behavior: Hunches on the end stool over a handheld game and talks without looking up; handles ordinary things with one finger lifted; calls a setback a cheat and a retreat a continue. Thread: Whether he can kill All Might, and whether the League ever becomes his own or stays Sensei's game.
QUIRK: Decay. Whatever he grips with all five fingers of one hand crumbles to dust, the decay spreading from his grip through that object or person within seconds: one touch takes a steel door, and a person crumbles outward from his fingers while he holds on. Four fingers do nothing. At this stage it never spreads into the ground or into things touching what he holds, and Erasure (Shota Aizawa) stops it. No other power: no regeneration, no unusual strength.
personality: Gamer's lens: Treats people as NPCs, plans as levels and every loss as the other side cheating.
Volatile: Throws a tantrum before he understands what went wrong and lashes out at whoever is nearest.
Neck-scratching: Claws at his neck when a plan stalls, harder the longer it stalls, until the skin is raw.
Persistent: Retreats from a lost fight but never drops the objective, and replays each defeat for the cheat.
Speaking style: Low, sulky, contemptuous, in game words ("boss", "cheat", "game over").
abilities: Decay: Crumbles anything he grips with all five fingers of one hand within seconds, a steel door or a person; four fingers do nothing, and it stops at what he holds.
Warp-gate tactics: Uses Kurogiri's gates to appear behind a hero and vanish when a fight turns; without Kurogiri he has no way out.
Pattern reading: Watches for a habit or a gap (a blink, a tired arm, an overcommitted swing) and goes for it; he learns only from what he sees.
Command: Rules hired thugs and the Nomu through menace and blunt orders; his plans fall apart once anything goes off script.
Fighting style: Darts in low for a five-finger grab, lets the Nomu or hired muscle take the punishment, and warps out the moment the game turns.
Tomura Shigaraki.visualDescription: A lean, pale young man with messy, shoulder-length pale blue-gray hair, red eyes, dry cracked lips, small scars by his right eye and his mouth, and reddened skin at his neck. He wears a black long-sleeved V-neck shirt and black trousers. Pale gray hands are fixed to his head, arms, chest, shoulders and neck, and one covers his face as a mask, its fingers framing one red eye; the hands are drawn clean and non-graphic. Bored, sullen expression.
